summary: Visual budgeting interface with Shift-click transaction range selection, explicit local-draft recovery, atomic selected-row categorization, stable edited rows under filters, full-header sorting, browser-saved collapsible navigation and a Transfers workspace for reviewed suggestions and manual pairs. Search opens from the compact register toolbar alongside the scoped filters, matching count and transaction actions; the table fills the remaining viewport. Account additions start from Accounts. Explicit Opening Balance categories remain distinct from Income/Transfer/Expense, with separate openingFunding budget and Insights display; zero opening entries remain explicitly reviewable without changing ordinary amount validation. Settings uses one responsive preferences window with persistent section navigation, direct browser-local Appearance and reviewed plugin changes. Account names in multi-account transaction rows show optional bank logos; sidebar accounts support browser-local custom ordering within budget-scope groups. The top-right eye masks monetary values across Web without changing financial data. Monetary displays round to comma-grouped whole currency units while editors and all saved/API values retain exact precision. Confirmed two-leg transfers expose signed dated transferFunding separately from income/spending, with complete graph verification for review eligibility.

operations.name: interface
operations.summary: Provide the declared web interface or remote authority adapter. The Insights page can render typed monthly stacked charts with inclusive month bounds, searchable multiple-choice Account, Category group and Category filters, grouping by Category or Group, a net line and a keyboard-accessible table. Amount privacy conceals the full chart and breakdown. Opening Balance is available in category creation and transaction pickers; openingFunding is displayed separately from income and included in the documented Ready to Assign equation. Technical categories never appear as expense envelopes. Settings opens Plugins with direct Budgets, Appearance, Budget history and About navigation; details stay in place with Back, Close and keyboard focus restoration. Accounts has the canonical /budgets/BUDGET/accounts address; legacy month/currency suffixes remain accepted. Archived disabled controls do not block leaving the page; actual unfinished writes retain normal guards. Account rows and sidebar share account_balance_position: money owned positive, debt negative, with explicit current/stale/estimated/unavailable status. Liabilities totals display negatively while public aggregate fields retain their original convention. YNAB estimates keep their signed value and never enter current totals, even with legacy false/missing flags.

output.description: The operation result in the enclosing response data field.

operations.side_effects: The interface delegates explicit reads/mutations to public services; it does not define financial rules. Account, Payee, Category and Memo resize controls save only column keys and pixel widths in browser local storage; resizing never writes financial data or history. Sidebar collapse/expand saves only expanded/collapsed under whab.sidebar in browser local storage. It never changes budget data, history or bank synchronization; blocked browser storage keeps the toggle usable for this page. Settings navigation alone does not mutate budgets. Appearance changes only the existing browser-local light/dark preference. Plugin changes retain explicit review, host confirmation and separate restart-save behavior; closing or navigating never retries an uncertain mutation. Signed balance presentation does not modify stored balances, transaction cash-flow signs, exact editor cents, review flags, pair links or bank state. Fixed privacy masks and display rounding remain unchanged.

operations.name: transfers.confirm
operations.summary: Transactions review panel: Explicitly confirm or unmatch two existing transactions in one atomic native operation. Preserve identities, financial fields, notes, source and original metadata. Matching preserves category attribution; unmatching clears any orphan Transfer label and its attribution. Both remain unreviewed for ordinary review. Complete valid pairs may assign or clear an optional Transfer label without unmatching; financial edits or choosing Expense, Income or Opening Balance require unmatching first. Historical closed/cross-scope accounts are supported. Explicit matching may pair two existing posted zero entries; automatic proposals exclude zeros.

operations.name: transactions.selected-category
operations.summary: Apply or clear one category on 1–100 explicit selected transactions using one guarded atomic edit; retain displayed rows until explicit refresh.

input.description: Required selected-row category choice. Click a checkbox then Shift-click another to select the inclusive loaded visible range in display order; Shift-click a checked endpoint to clear that range. Outside selections stay unchanged. Repeated Shift-clicks retain the last ordinary click as anchor. Clear/select-all/filter/navigation resets the anchor; hidden, disabled and unloaded rows are excluded. Selection alone never writes data, and existing 1–100 edit limits still apply. Revision/request ID are obtained internally by the browser.

categoryId.description: Existing same-currency child ID; null clears. Omission is invalid.

output.description: Native data containing count, changed, and exact before/after changes after the guarded commit or read-only preview.

operations.side_effects: Read-only internal preview, followed only by an explicit user category change by one native edit_transactions commit/checkpoint and reversible audit entry. Preserve review, note, financial fields and identities; manual category choice clears prior category attribution. All invalid targets reject the whole batch. No synchronization.

operations.side_effects: Drops all unsaved local row/form drafts in this view, cancels local autosave timers and releases the beforeunload guard. operations.name: appearance.amounts
operations.summary: Top-right eye: Hide amounts replaces known and unavailable monetary fields with the same $X,XXX placeholder for USD (CODE X,XXX for other known currencies), independent of magnitude, sign, decimal precision or availability. Amount cells retain their sizing and alignment. When shown, monetary displays round to whole units; editing reveals exact currency precision. Covers balances, budgets, transactions, reports, monetary tooltips/accessibility labels and opaque chart/receipt/history regions.

state.description: Browser display preference. New browsers default to shown; the eye toggles the current state.

input.description: Browser-local display preference; chosen through the eye control.

state.description: Applied display state for this page.

output.description: Display state applied in the current Web page.

operations.side_effects: Writes only whab.amounts=shown|hidden in browser localStorage. Applies across budgets/workspaces in the same origin, before paint and to dynamic fragments; other tabs follow changes. Does not save or modify financial fields, drafts, history or sync. Hidden monetary editors offer Show amounts to edit and restore the exact draft/focus. CLI, API, exports and stored values are unchanged; arbitrary numeric text in names/memos is not scrubbed. The mask never reads the amount to determine its length. Unknown-currency monetary fields use X,XXX; opaque content and raw history without currency remain generic XX. Display rounding uses nearest whole units with halves away from zero; no-op focus/blur never saves rounded data. New-entry and settings amount forms keep exact precision. Counts, percentages, quantities, free text and opaque raw audit/plugin payloads are not reinterpreted. Shown amounts use comma thousands separators (68000.00 displays as 68,000); exact editors remain ungrouped.
